Cleartrip detail pages 18-19 Nov 2026 (check-in date 18/11/2026 confirmed per page): Dee Grand Marq Hotel and The Zurfis Hotel (3-star listing) return 'No rooms available'; The Zurfis Hotel (2-star listing) shows 2,669 and Konka Guest House shows 2,136, both PRE-TAX. stay.notes: Zanskar status: non-official guides say the valley is cut off from about November to May (Pensi La closes with winter snow, Shinku La closes early October), guesthouses and homestays reopen in late June, and only pre-arranged groups (Chadar trek, January-February) stay in winter. No official Ladakh tourism closure notice or tariff was found (kargil.nic.in lists a Tourist Bungalow and Tourist Complex at Padum with no rates). Two Cleartrip rates exist for the night (Zurfis 2,669, Konka 2,136 pre-tax) but with roads closed and 2 of 4 listings sold out, they are unconfirmed and are not turned into medians. No published season tariff found. Nothing borrowed from Leh or any other town.
